name: [🎲UPD!] Cave Casualties
desc:
CAVE CASUALTIES is a brutal, realistic cave-diving survival psychological horror/thriller game where every expedition takes you deeper into an unforgiving underground world,
Your only objective is to descend as far as possible and make it back ALIVE
🕳️ Descend through a massive abyss of dangerous caves
🩺 Survive a detailed physical and mental health system
🦠 Monitor wounds, infections, exhaustion, anxiety, and more
⚠️ Face consequences for every careless decision
🔦 Push deeper while your condition becomes increasingly unstable
💀 Learn from painful deaths and attempt to beat your previous depth
🏆 Discover just how far you can make it before everything goes wrong
🎭 Mimics that are able to replicate your friends

An independent Roblox tough cave-survival game inspired in part by "Casualties: Unknown". Not affiliated with or endorsed by its creators. No assets, artwork, or models from Casualties: Unknown are used, all credits go to their official creators respectfully

llm.loop: descend into caves -> manage wounds, infections, exhaustion and anxiety -> push deeper -> try to return alive -> beat previous depth
llm.objectives: descend as far as possible and make it back alive
llm.progression: personal best depth; coins and permanent gear (pickaxe, rope)
llm.instructions: descend through the abyss, survive the physical and mental health system, learn from deaths, beat previous depth; watch for mimics copying friends
unique: detailed body and mental health simulation
llm.thumbnails: bandaged cat-like characters in cave gear, medkit, a '???' grey creature, 'LIMITED CODE: FERALMODE' and a 'help me / nah' meme-style prompt
llm.complexity_notes: large vertical cave world, detailed health/sanity systems, mimic AI, co-op lifts
